_label: SYNTHETIC W-C02-07: pattern file of T-W07-7SCAN (tests/C02/W-C02-07/T-W07-7SCAN_test_file_scan.md). It holds patterns only, no token, key or password. The token patterns are those of shared/token_format.md section 3, which holds if the two differ. The guard patterns are copied from .claude/hooks/tool_allowlist.py at main db2ebd9 (REDACT, lines 416 to 418; CREDENTIAL_VARS, lines 149 to 151); the scan re-reads the guard file at run time and gives COULD NOT CHECK if they differ.

extra_value_patterns._why: Point 7 asks for no key or password value; README section 4 (a) lists these shapes for raw output. Each hit is classified by classify_rule below.

classify_rule._fixed_before_the_run: W-C02-07 phase B, Group D, 2026-10-12. A hit is a VALUE (a finding) or a NAME (reported, not a finding), by these rules only, in this order.
classify_rule.1: Every hit of a token finder pattern, of guard_redact patterns 1 to 4, of jwt_like, of supabase_key_like or of connection_string_with_password is a VALUE.
classify_rule.2: A hit of guard_redact pattern 5 is judged on its value part (the text after '=' or ':'), with these characters stripped from both ends: quotes, backticks, commas, semicolons, full stops, brackets and braces. It is a NAME if the stripped value part is empty; or starts with '$', '<', '{', '[', '%', '(' or '`'; or is one of the words in name_words, in any case; or is shorter than 16 characters; or holds no digit. Otherwise it is a VALUE.
classify_rule.3: A hit of long_hex is a NAME if it is a run of one repeated character, if it lies in a git object ID context ('commit ', 'sha ', '@', 'blob ' or 'at ' within the 8 characters before it), or if it holds no digit or no letter. Otherwise it is a VALUE. A hit of long_base64 that is not also a long_hex hit is a NAME if it is a run of one repeated character, or if it lacks a digit, a capital letter or a small letter. Otherwise it is a VALUE.
classify_rule.4: A CREDENTIAL_VARS expansion ($NAME or ${NAME}) is a NAME: it names a variable and holds no value. It is reported with its path and line, since a test must not expand one.
